name: 整條街都搬走了
caption: 電話打不通。作坊的燈卻還亮著。
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one close-up evidence photograph for a Taiwanese folk-horror game, landscape3:2. Meticulously realistic physical object, tactile worn materials, shallow but sufficient depth of field with key clues all in focus, practical flashlight and muted amber spill, damp abandoned Taiwanese mountain temple in2026, grounded documentary photography. Suspense from concrete evidence rather than monsters. One coherent photograph, not collage or split panels. No captions, no UI, no watermark, no extraneous lettering. Keep important object well exposed and complete in frame. Subject: Rusted village notice board behind cracked glass in deserted rural Taiwan, dominant white municipal-looking evacuation sheet with clearly handwritten '2024' and Traditional Chinese heading '遷離公告', no official emblems. Beneath is a small yellowed ritual notice with only '七月初一' and '借一聲，還一尊'. A wet finger streak trails down glass across the old address line. Real humid paper layers, no giant text overlay. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: This must be a frightening NIGHT-TIME location photograph, NOT a clean studio product shot or daytime illustration. Background falls into deep near-black darkness, only a narrow off-camera FLASHLIGHT beam with faint dying candle spill reveals the evidence. Surroundings ancient, neglected, water-damaged, cracked wood, mold, cobwebs, grime, realistic soot. Low-key cold desaturated green-black shadows, dirty muted amber highlights. Claustrophobic, unsettling horror-film realism, fine believable materials. No sunshine, bright window, white studio backdrop, glossy showroom, excessive fog hiding clues, or comic illustration. Keep clue readable in the flashlight pool; do not underexpose the key object.
